subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Resistance and Resistors
description: Learn Resistance and Resistors in one minute.

hook.text: Every material fights current flow. That fight is called resistance.

buildup.text: Thin wires have more resistance than thick ones. Longer wires resist more too.

discovery.text: Resistors are components designed to add precise amounts of resistance on purpose.

twist.text: Color bands on a resistor encode its value — each stripe is a digit.

climax.text: Without resistors, current would surge unchecked and fry every component.

punchline.text: Resistance isn't the enemy — it's the traffic cop.

quiz.question: Why are resistors used in circuits?
options: To add precise resistance and control current flow
To store energy for later use
